title: AgriSense: Vision-Language Decision Support and Robotic Intervention in a Virtual Greenhouse Copy title
abstract: arXiv:2611.16752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous greenhouse management increasingly requires robotic systems that integrate perception, navigation, environmental regulation, and plant-level intervention. This paper presents AgriSense, a framework combining an Isaac Sim virtual greenhouse, a quadruped mobile manipulator, RGB and LiDAR-inertial sensing, environmental control, and supervised vision-language decision support. Frozen DINOv2 and BERT encoders, together with structured environmental inputs, support joint prediction of twelve environmental references, a target zone, and an intervention flag. Checkpoint replay reproduces 41/43 zone decisions. Across five seeds on a source-grouped test set, the full, image-removed, and language-removed configurations each achieve 43/44 correct zone decisions, providing no evidence of incremental multimodal zone-accuracy improvement. translated_title: AgriSense：虚拟温室中的视觉-语言决策支持与机器人干预
translated_abstract: 自主温室管理日益需要集感知、导航、环境调节和植物级干预于一体的机器人系统。本文提出AgriSense，一个结合Isaac Sim虚拟温室、四足移动操作机器人、RGB与激光雷达-惯性传感、环境控制以及监督式视觉-语言决策支持的框架。冻结的DINOv2和BERT编码器结合结构化环境输入，支持对十二个环境参考值、一个目标区域和一个干预标志的联合预测。检查点回放复现了41/43的区域决策。在源分组测试集上跨五个随机种子，完整配置、去除图像配置和去除语言配置均达到43/44的正确区域决策，未提供多模态融合在区域准确率上带来增量提升的证据。完整模型在温度上取得0.249摄氏度的平均绝对误差，2.030个百分点的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AgriSense框架，将Isaac Sim虚拟温室、四足移动操作机器人与冻结的DINOv2/BERT视觉-语言编码器相结合，实现对环境参考值、目标区域和干预决策的联合预测，并诚实地报告了多模态融合在区域决策准确率上未见增量提升。
en_tdlr: AgriSense combines an Isaac Sim virtual greenhouse, a quadruped mobile manipulator, and frozen DINOv2/BERT vision-language encoders to jointly predict environmental references, target zones, and intervention flags, while honestly reporting no evidence of incremental multimodal gains in zone decision accuracy.
